slides.texte_overlay:
5 tiny rules that changed
how i spend my free time

phone stays in the bag

when i meet a friend, my phone stays in my bag the whole time. conversations got longer and deeper, and i finally remember what we actually talked about.

one new place a month

i visit one place i've never been every month: a museum, a park, a cafe. it's a tiny rule, but it made my weekends feel like actual memories instead of a blur.

nothing before nine

i don't check messages before nine on weekends. those quiet morning hours became my favourite part of the week, and nothing urgent ever happened while i waited.

learn before you watch

i learn one small thing before i let myself watch anything: a word, a fact, a painting. five minutes of learning first made the rest of my evening feel earned.

slides.texte_overlay:
say yes to one invite

i say yes to at least one invitation a week, even when i'm tempted to stay in. the evenings i almost skipped turned into some of my best memories this year.
